subject: fix(track-work): expose atomic decision supersession
diff_check: patch -p1 of workspace/change.diff onto an archive of the parent reproduces the clean and seeded trees for these paths (checked)

clean.description: The change as committed. No defect is planted.

seeded.class_note: Requested class was security. Not provable: validateModel (model.mjs:362-372, called from commands.mjs mutateExisting) rejects any supersedes or supersededBy that is not an existing decision ID, so trailing text never persists except as whitespace, and no value reaches the record that can inject content. Classified as logic, which the task allowed for this case.
seeded.description: The decision reference check uses /^D-\d{3}/ without the end anchor. It accepts a value that starts with a D-NNN reference and then has extra text, including a trailing newline. The commit's rule is that a malformed reference fails with invalid-decision-reference and nothing is written. With the seed, supersedes: "D-001\n" is accepted and written as a Supersedes link to D-001. Values with trailing text fail later with candidate-validation-failure instead of invalid-decision-reference.

proof.method: test passes on clean and fails on seeded (logic)
